case.scientific_claim: For the declared HSP90 round-2 MD packet, a fixed two-readout directional-block catalogue can be reported only as a same-packet, trajectory-level descriptive diagnostic under the declared persistence grid.

claim_contract.allowed_wording: Describe persistent two-readout directional departure and return candidates under the frozen 5/20/50 saved-frame grid.
claim_contract.forbidden_wording: Do not infer a transition rate, equilibrium, population, free energy, complete pathway, mechanism, or mutation effect.

evidence_items.native_observable: Ordered per-frame two-readout directional signs derived from geometry_delta_A and contact_margin_A.
evidence_items.estimand: Within-trajectory catalogue of persistent directional blocks at fixed horizons; it is not an equilibrium or kinetic estimand.
evidence_items.spatial_support: Existing HSP90 round-2 trajectory-derived geometry/contact readouts under the frozen two-readout rule.
evidence_items.unit_or_aggregation: trajectory (n=40); frames are correlated within-trajectory observations

case_provenance.admission_boundary: Human-authored exposed-development CaseGraph. It admits only the existing same-packet descriptive question and does not validate source science or permit a kinetic, equilibrium, or mechanistic claim.
